Proposal: Demolition of existing garage/workshop and summerhouse; construction of new outbuilding containing garage/workshop and store at ground floor level and home office at first floor level. Decision: Permitted. Decision Issued Date: 28/11/2024. Official documents include Location Plan drawing SLP1; Site Block and Location Plans drawing 24 06 P2; and Proposed Plans and Elevations drawing 24 O6 P1 - B. The official proposal identifies one new outbuilding; the garage/workshop, store and home office are uses within the same distinct structure. The site/block plan and dedicated proposed plans/elevations support the same single planned structure. Geometry/materialization is deferred to local OpenCode.
